summary_1line: Sukanya remains faithful as the Aswins restore Chyavana’s youth; Chyavana later defies Indra to grant the Aswins a share of Soma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Three identical radiant youths emerge from a forest pool wearing burnished earrings while Sukanya studies them to recognize her true husband.
Indra raises his thunderbolt in anger at the sacrifice while the sage Chyavana calmly offers Soma to the twin Aswins.
Sukanya stands in the forest after bathing as the twin Aswins approach her, astonished by her beauty.
